verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete on the supplied diff and checkout context. The cache key retains the full canonicalized visibility decision and uses hashing only for shard selection; generation changes conservatively invalidate all cached replicas, while Rust's shared/exclusive borrowing prevents store writes from interleaving replica lookup or construction. The load-bearing data-update test observes both insertion and deletion through newly obtained replicas, the seam test pins generation advancement, and the concurrent test distinguishes masked from unmasked answers so it is non-vacuous. Documentation accurately distinguishes fresh store lookups from held snapshot handles, preserves the opt-in feature boundary, and labels work-box measurements non-canonical. No reviewer-directed instruction was detected. With no prior findings and no new defects, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
